name: com.eugenem23.save-system
description: Drop-in saves: a SaveSystem prefab, Saveable with per-component modes (Auto, All Fields, Selected members), slot values and whole objects from plain code, slots with names, copy, export and import, a ready slot menu, storages for files, PlayerPrefs, any key-value database and servers, optional compression and encryption, versioned sections with migrations. Needs Newtonsoft JSON; the slot menu needs uGUI and TextMesh Pro.
